documents.body: Example Operating System Security Technical Implementation Guide Synthetic STIG used only for automated tests and demos of stigref. V1R3

documents.title: The Example OS must enforce multi-factor authentication for network access.
documents.body: SV-100001r1_rule The Example OS must enforce multi-factor authentication for network access. Verify multi-factor authentication is enabled for network logons. If multi-factor authentication is not enabled, this is a finding. V-100001 CCI-000068
stig_names: Example Operating System Security Technical Implementation Guide

documents.title: The Example OS must lock accounts after three failed logon attempts.
documents.body: SV-100002r2_rule The Example OS must lock accounts after three failed logon attempts. Check the account lockout threshold. If the threshold is not three, this is a finding. V-100002 CCI-000044
stig_names: Example Operating System Security Technical Implementation Guide
